temporal_notes: Larval collections conducted during the trial period between August and November 2011 for WHO susceptibility testing.
coord_source_text: The trials were carried out at the Centre Muraz experimental hut station in Valley du Kou 5 (4°25'W, 11°24'N) situated near Bobo-Dioulasso, in South-western Burkina Faso.
source_text: During the trials, samples of adult An. gambiae which emerged from larvae collected from the experimental hut site (Valley du Kou 5) were tested in WHO test kits for susceptibility to pyrethroids using deltamethrin 0.05% treated papers and to organophosphates using p-methyl 0.25% treated papers.

temporal_notes: Single intervention trial (Trial 1), lasting 6 weeks between August and November 2011.
coord_source_text: The trials were carried out at the Centre Muraz experimental hut station in Valley du Kou 5 (4°25'W, 11°24'N) situated near Bobo-Dioulasso, in South-western Burkina Faso.
source_text: A total of 3933 An gambiae ss were collected from the experimental huts during the trial.

temporal_notes: First combined intervention trial (Trial 2), lasting 6 weeks between August and November 2011.
coord_source_text: The trials were carried out at the Centre Muraz experimental hut station in Valley du Kou 5 (4°25'W, 11°24'N) situated near Bobo-Dioulasso, in South-western Burkina Faso.
source_text: A total of 320 An gambiae ss were collected from the experimental huts during the second trial, far fewer than in the first trial.
